Hi Elena / Tessa — technical notes to feed into the kickoff doc: 

SSO / SAML (Monica):
- We support SAML 2.0 standard metadata exchange. Primary required attributes: email (NameID/emailAddress), givenName, familyName. Optional: groups (we map to roles).
- We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. For auto-provisioning we prefer SCIM for full lifecycle; SAML JIT provisioning is supported for basic creation but lacks group sync.
- Example metadata file naming: redwood-luma-prd-metadata.xml

SCIM (Ben & Monica):
- SCIM v2 endpoints; OAuth2 Bearer token recommended. We can support mTLS if your security policy requires it (will need CA cert exchange prior to cutover).
- Default provisioning scope: users + group membership (recommended). If you prefer users-only, we can provide mapping rules.
- Rate guidance: up to 50 user ops / sec for initial sync; give us a heads up for bulk provisioning windows.

IP allowlist / networking (Jonas):
- Published egress ranges (production): 52.14.120.0/22, 52.28.64.0/22. We can provide a signed list; changes communicated 48–72 hours in advance for scheduled changes, emergency rotation window is 2 hours with pre-authorized failover plan.

Service accounts & org policy (internal):
- Naming convention: redwood-luma-<env>-svc-<role> (e.g., redwood-luma-prd-svc-scim).
- Least-privilege: service accounts scoped to provisioning and read-only audit for production. Token rotation every 90 days unless you require shorter TTLs.
- Audit/event retention: standard 90 days; extended retention can be added to the contract.

I've attached a short plaintext with our recommended service account names and a starter SAML attribute mapping: saml-scim-service-account-naming.txt

Next step: I can drop an implementation checklist into the Drive doc and pre-fill suggested names for your SSO team.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
